llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Kia Access MCP setup guide for reading and controlling the user's own vehicle, with clear warnings and confirmation steps for write actions.

dimensions.detail: Access to Kia credentials, vehicle location, and remote vehicle controls is sensitive but proportionate to the vehicle-management purpose and constrained by `KIA_WRITE_MODE` and confirmations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses an npm MCP server via `npx -y kiaaccess-mcp` and requires Kia credentials in MCP environment configuration; this is disclosed but means the user must trust the external package and account handling.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to Kia vehicle requests, require listing vehicles instead of guessing identifiers, and require confirmation for login bootstrap, session deletion, and every vehicle command.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses a local remember-me token stored under `~/.kiaaccess-mcp/session.json` that refreshes sessions silently, and provides a confirmation-gated `kia_forget_session` removal path.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The described capabilities match the stated purpose: Kia account login, vehicle status, location, EV charging, climate, and optional lock/unlock commands for the user's own vehicle.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the `kiaaccess-mcp` npm package with your Kia credentials, location data, and vehicle controls. Use `KIA_WRITE_MODE=none` for read-only use, avoid enabling door unlock unless needed, and remove the local session with `kia_forget_session` if you no longer want persistent access.
llm.findings: [AS2] expected: The artifact mentions `.mcp.json` and `~/.claude/mcp.json` as setup locations for adding this MCP server; I did not find instructions to read existing MCP configs, discover other integrations, or extract MCP secrets.
